# Maps (The Vault)

The map pictures in `app/src/main/assets/maps/` are **adaptations** of these works, re-inked in the
app's palette and re-lettered in Cormorant Garamond by `tools/maps/build_maps.py`, then cut into
tiles. As the originals require, the adapted maps are shared under the same licence,
**CC BY-SA 4.0** (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).

| Asset | Original | Author | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `middle_earth` | [Map of Middle-Earth.svg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Map_of_Middle-Earth.svg) ([mapome](https://github.com/k1tesurfen/mapome)) | k1tesurfen | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| `the_shire` | [Sketch Map of The Shire.svg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sketch_Map_of_The_Shire.svg) | Chiswick Chap | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| `pelennor` | [Battle of the Pelennor Fields.svg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Battle_of_the_Pelennor_Fields.svg) | Ian Alexander | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| `beleriand` | [Sketch Map of Beleriand.svg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sketch_Map_of_Beleriand.svg) | Chiswick Chap | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| `numenor` | [Númenor Sketch Map.svg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:N%C3%BAmenor_Sketch_Map.svg) | Ian Alexander | CC BY-SA 4.0 |

Each map's credit is also shown in the app, on its Vault card and on the map itself.

The place descriptions and journey notes in `Atlas.kt` are original text written for this app.
